name: Flexpak Colorado
old_description: Flexpak has the capability to create a package for anything. Any size, shape, design or quantity.
about:
Flexpak Colorado operates from Aurora, Colorado, and maintains facilities across the United States. The company has over 25 years of experience in packaging solutions, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company provides custom packaging design and manufacturing, packaging equipment and automation integration, distribution of thousands of packaging products and facility supplies, and custom foam and mold fabrication. It partners with leading suppliers to deliver the latest packaging automation technology. Flexpak describes itself as one of the West's largest and fastest-growing packaging companies, with a national footprint through its membership in the Packaging Distributors of America.

Flexpak serves a broad range of industries, citing examples from aerospace (rocket motors) to food and beverage (root beer). Its customer base includes businesses that ship, display, or sell products requiring custom packaging solutions. The company's national presence allows it to service customers across multiple sectors.

Flexpak differentiates itself through a service philosophy it calls "Expect Extraordinary," pledging never to lose a customer based on service. The company also commits to a 21% absolute reduction in Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 2029 from a 2024 baseline, aligning with the Paris Agreement goals.
